title: Power and Electricity Units
summary: P = W ÷ t, the watt, and the kilowatt-hour: the 'unit' on your electricity bill.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 7: Work, Energy and Simple Machines

objectives: I can calculate power using P = W ÷ t.
I can convert between J, W, kW and kWh.
I can calculate the cost of using electrical appliances.
misconceptions: Power and energy mean the same thing.
A kilowatt-hour is a unit of power.
A more powerful machine does more work.
